policy: Readiness is demonstrated, not assigned by age. These are entry routes, not complete stage-specific curricula.

stages.title: Grounding
stages.readiness: Supported reading, observation, counting and consent; accessible alternatives agreed with a facilitator
stages.practice: Read a complete age-appropriate work; keep observations; perform a safe household task with support
stages.assessment: Explain and demonstrate without generated answers; identify when help is needed

stages.title: Foundations
stages.readiness: Algebra, sustained reading and source comparison; diagnose gaps before advanced texts
stages.practice: Reconstruct a proof, parse a paragraph, compare evidence and measure retained learning
stages.assessment: Closed-resource reconstruction and an unfamiliar example

stages.title: Apprenticeship
stages.readiness: Relevant foundations, safety induction and a qualified supervisor
stages.practice: Complete and revise a real task under external quality standards
stages.assessment: Observed execution, correction of failure and supervisor critique

stages.title: Independent formation
stages.readiness: Reliable self-assessment, prerequisite closure and practical risk judgment
stages.practice: Design a personal curriculum, conduct field inquiry and maintain an accountable project
stages.assessment: Independent review, unfamiliar transfer and delayed retest

stages.title: Advanced Open Frontier
stages.readiness: Relevant technical core plus serious specialization depth and domain safety review
stages.practice: Reproduce, extend and integrate a specialization result; publish limits and negative findings
stages.assessment: Expert-reviewed artifact, novel perturbation, provenance audit and human defense

stages.title: Lifelong renewal
stages.readiness: Prior learning evidence and an honest account of changed capacities or circumstances
stages.practice: Revisit a former capability, learn an unfamiliar domain and revise commitments
stages.assessment: Delayed retrieval, new-context performance, responsible help-seeking and decision review
